name: Hotel Plaza e de Russie
positioning: Historic seaside hotel from 1871 on Viareggio's promenade in the Art Nouveau district, with designer rooms and two penthouse suites with private terraces
best_for: Travelers who want a historic hotel on a Tuscan seaside promenade
Couples drawn to penthouse suites with private terraces
Families wanting a suite a stone's throw from the beach

facts.text: The hotel is situated along a seaside promenade.
The hotel was erected in 1871 along the route of the Grand Tour.
The hotel describes itself as Viareggio's oldest hotel.
Past guests included the poet Rainer Maria Rilke and Giacomo Puccini.
Each room has bathroom tiles with evocative geometries.
The Family Suite offers space and privacy a stone's throw from the beach.
Lunasia Restaurant offers gourmet dining in a glamorous setting.
From the hotel, guests can visit Tuscan art cities, Elba Island and the Cinque Terre.
Nearby cultural events include the Puccini Festival of Torre del Lago and the Carnival of Viareggio.

highlights.text: The two penthouse suites have private terraces spanning the entire suite and full-length French doors.
The 'de Russie' name comes from Russian expatriates and aristocrats who found shelter at the hotel.
The hotel is in Viareggio's seaside Art Nouveau district.
Each room has its own character, with precious fabrics, warm understated tones and Italian design details.

considerations.text: The Junior Suite has a quiet internal outlook.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing that reflects the hotel's exclusive positioning.
